page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc7.3xlarge is a compute-optimized instance from the high clock speed family powered by the KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile features an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at a base clock of 3.3 GHz. It provides 12 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 6 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The instance integrates 24.0 GB of memory, which establishes a compute-dense ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware cache specifications include 32 KB L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a shared 33 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, AVX-512 BF16, and AES.

The instance does not bundle local disk storage and requires network-attached cloud storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is delivered with a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. Accelerator options are not present, as the server includes zero GPUs.

Benchmark testing shows consistent mid-tier performance across varied computational tasks. The instance achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 1336.0 and a multi-core score of 6834.0, while PassMark registered a CPU mark of 14001.56. Compiling software with Clang reached 11273.0, and static web serving throughput reached 10.62 GB/sec. Memory subsystem bandwidth measured 70.8 GB/sec for uncached read operations and 47.41 GB/sec for uncached write operations. In-memory data store performance yielded 12.13 million operations per second during Redis SET benchmarks.

Tradeoffs for this configuration center on the 1:2 memory-to-vCPU allocation, which constrains workloads that demand large in-memory caches or wide analytical data sets. In small model (135M) LLM prompt processing, the processor sustained 773.56 tokens per second, but 7B model prompt processing dropped to a weak 17.92 tokens per second due to the lack of hardware accelerators and restricted memory footprint. This server type is best matched with continuous integration builds, microservices, web application serving, batch processing, and moderate database workloads where high frequency execution takes priority over extreme memory scale.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc7.3xlarge is a compute-oriented virtual machine from the high clock speed instance family, built on the x86_64 architecture with a KVM hypervisor. Powered by a 3.3 GHz Intel Xeon 8369HB processor, it allocates 12 dedicated vCPUs derived from 6 physical cores alongside 24.0 GB of system memory, matching a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The processor includes 33 MB of L3 cache, AVX-512, and AVX-512 VNNI extensions. The instance carries no bundled local storage and contains zero GPUs, relying on a 4 Gbps baseline network interface for host communication. Benchmark testing reveals solid standard compute capability, achieving a Geekbench multi-core rating of 6834.0 and 12.13 million Redis SET operations per second. However, the limited memory allocation and reliance on remote storage limit dense data analytics. The instance is suited for CI/CD compilation, web serving, and compute-focused backend processing.
